notes.title: Announcing my new game: Little Aviary!
notes.content: [p]Hello! [/p][p]Yesterday I announced my new game Little Aviary, a bottom-of-the-screen bird collector! I also wanted to make a creature collector and my partner is an avid bird watcher so that’s where Little Aviary was born! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576294/2e30f5124af846bfd8c954983bfcb008fdc5168d.gif"][/img][/p][p]What to expect in Little Aviary:[/p][list][*][p]birds[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3437350/Little_Aviary/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]You can check out the reveal trailer below![/p][previewyoutube="fkaqtTMXwJY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]I announced it as part of the Back to School celebration, be sure to[url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Mooncube/sale/BacktoSchoolGamesCelebration2025"] checkout all the other cool games in the event[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]I'm also starting a playtest for the game this week and I'd love to get as much feedback as possible so please sign up if you're interested![/p][p][/p][p]I hope you have a good time with Little Aviary and thank you all for the support with Tranquil Isle! 💙[/p][p][/p][p]- Tom[/p]

notes.title: Tranquil Isle update 1.1!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43679632/7eb4fb3d0f34be8dcdc0d474190cb95306305d26.png[/img]

Hello! It's been a little over a month since Tranquil Isle released and I've been working on some changes/fixes! 

Future updates will mostly be visual stuff now that most of the bugs/QOL stuff has been addressed!

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the building budget in sandbox mode
[*] The "visit 30 islands" achievement now counts each unlocked island instead of just each level
[*] Iron deposits now spawn a little more often
[*] Tweaked the building unlocks a bit to reduce the end game being a lot of the same buildings
[*] A couple small QOL things
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The blacksmith is now buffed by the iron mine not the quarry (whoops)
[*] Bridges shouldn't be awarded after unlocking all islands anymore
[*] Buffed the market
[*] Clamped the glow of buildings in build mode
[*] Fixed some controller nav bugs
[/list]
Thanks again for playing my little game!

- Tom

notes.title: Small fixes & a big thank you!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43679632/7eb4fb3d0f34be8dcdc0d474190cb95306305d26.png[/img]

Hello!

Just want to start by saying [b]thank you[/b] for playing my little game and giving me a bunch of great feedback both before and after release, this launch has been such a great experience!

I wanted to do a quick recap of the changes/fixes made since launch;
[list]
[*] Fixed tutorial not showing for everyone
[*] Fixed some islands not getting unlocked properly in classic mode
[*] Fixed some of the building collisions
[*] Terrain colors now save between islands
[*] Removed the tutorial from sandbox mode (unless toggled on in settings)
[/list]

That's everything for now, please continue letting me know if you run into any issues or anything!

Thanks :)
- Tom

notes.title: Tranquil Isle is OUT NOW!!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I can’t believe the day has finally come to say…
[h3]My first game, Tranquil Isle, is out now!!! 🎉
[/h3]
[previewyoutube=mkz8ZOmekek;full][/previewyoutube]

What to expect from Tranquil Isle:

🏝️ Test your skills in Classic Mode, where you must build up your high score and unlock new buildings and islands through strategic building placement
🏝️ Chill out in Sandbox Mode and build purely for aesthetics & vibes
🏝️ Try out the Daily Challenge, where you can compete against other players on the same fixed map!
🏝️ There’s no need to stress about combat or trading, just foxxus on making your islands as best or as cozy as possible!

I’ve had a very fun, challenging and rewarding couple of years working on this, so I’m very excited to bring you the full game ♥️. To those of you who playtested and sent feedback, thank you so much for your input, you have really shaped the game into something I hope we can all be proud of! 

If you haven’t already you can join the [url=https://discord.gg/a5ArtQr8uQ]Discord server here[/url] to share your thoughts, experience and creations with me! I love to see them 🤩

For now I will leave you to enjoy the tranquility of Tranquil Isle 🌞

- Tom ✨

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
Tranquil Isle releases tomorrow!! 🥳🎉 And ahead of the release I just wanted to let people know it works great on Steam Deck!

[h1]Controls[/h1]
This is the default controller layout, but some of the controls are rebindable in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43679632/97d635dbe258c0fe8de7367932ae4f48c6c5c782.png[/img]

[h1]Performance[/h1]
To give you an idea of how performance will look, here are a variety of graphics settings combinations and configured TDP values:

High - High at 15w hits stable 60fps

Medium - Medium at 10W TDP hits stable 60fps

Low - Low at 5W TDP hits stable 30fps
Low - Low at 15W TDP hits stable 100fps+

My suggestion is to play the game at Medium quality, TAA anti-aliasing for the best visual experience whilst maintaining solid performance.

[h1]Support[/h1]
If you have any questions/problems let me know through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2324180/discussions/]Steam discussions[/url] or by joining the [url=https://discord.com/invite/7UyDc7ugRV]Discord server[/url]!

- Tom

notes.title: Release date announcement and a ✨ brand new demo ✨
notes.content:
Hey all,

I’m super excited to be writing this update for everyone today as I can finally announce the release date for my debut game: 

[h3]🏝️ Tranquil Isle will be yours April 18th!! 🏝️[/h3]

[previewyoutube=y2Dlc7Cleh4;full][trailer][/previewyoutube]

I can’t wait for you all to play the full game and share your cozy builds with me!
In the meantime, I have just dropped a brand new demo to keep you busy up until launch. I’ve made lots of big changes to reflect the final game so if you played the old demo, you should definitely check this one out too!

Demo features:
[list]
[*]Classic mode: The last demo was sandbox mode only, so this update means you’ll get a real taste of the main game and how it actually works! 🏝️
[*]Lots of new decorations (including my personal favourite - a pond!) 💧
[*]New island colour palettes to brighten your day 🎨
[/list]

I have also been working hard to implement demo/playtest feedback, so for those of you who have sent ideas my way, hopefully you’ll get to see them in the demo, if not the main game when it launches next month!

I hope you enjoy the demo and I’ll see you on the 18th for launch 🥳

- Tom ✨

notes.title: Introducing Tranquil Isle!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Tom Daly here, developer of Tranquil Isle. Maybe you read about the game in the Wholesome newsletter, or just happened to see it while scrolling. Either way – welcome!

Tranquil Isle is a combination of townbuilder and roguelite, all about building towns in a randomly generated sunkissed island paradise. If you’re looking to just chill out and build, there’s also a sandbox mode. The game is a small-scale, lo-fi experience, all about whiling away the hours somewhere pretty. 

This is a solo developed project, but I’ve also teamed up with an indie publisher Future Friends Games, who’ve worked on solo indie games like Omno and Exo One and the upcoming Laysara, Gourdlets and Summerhouse. They’re helping me go the extra mile with polish and promotional stuff, which is really cool!

Check out the reveal trailer below:

[previewyoutube=nRHDugQ06kw;full][/previewyoutube]

This is my first time developing a full game, so I’m super grateful for any support I can get. If you like the look of the game please add it to your wishlist! 

Thanks so much,

Tom
